text:
maria_p: Quick sync — proposing a small change to our SI co-sell intake gating. Problem: when cloud marketplace or HW partners touch an account we get messy ownership flips. Proposal: three intake buckets: 1) Sales-owned, 2) Co-owned (SI + Redwood), 3) SI-owned. Need rules for auto-routing, acceptance window, and announcement gating. Ping @dan_s @hao_w @olivia_r for ops + routing thoughts.
dan_s: +1. We've been losing momentum when SI claims late. Suggestion: use lead_score + ARR threshold > $50k to auto-consider co-owned. Otherwise default to sales. Also want a clear 'claim' action in the CRM.
hao_w: Agree on thresholds. Two asks from SI side: (A) SI needs a 72-hour window to accept a co-sell assignment, (B) carve-out if SI has active PO/contract or engaged in last 12 months (then SI takes precedence). If no acceptance in 72h -> sales automatically owns.
olivia_r: We can implement a SFDC field 'SI_co_sell_state' with values [pending, accepted, rejected, expired] and an automation for the 72h timer + reminders. Need exact routing rules spelled out so we don't get duplicates. Who will set initial 'pending'? (partnerships or intake form?)
maria_p: Partnerships would set the initial pending flag when an intake hits marketplace/hw/si channel or when AE tags the record. We'll include intake checklist fields: partner_name, intro_date, previous_engagement (yes/no), estimated_ARR.
jess_legal: For joint announcements, we need an 'announcement readiness' checklist: MOU signed (or LOI), approved joint talking points, logo usage rights, and sandbox access for demo. Legal can produce a lightweight MOU template + press checklist. SLA: 2 business days for legal review for standard partners.
dan_s: Sounds good. Operational summary: RevOps builds SFDC fields + automation; Partnerships owns playbook and intake checklist; SI partner manager confirms acceptance windows; Sales updates AE playbook. Target: pilot next Tue? :thumbsup:
hao_w: We can pilot with EdgeWorks and CloudForge — will confirm with both partners by EOD today. Also: recommend a ‘no-touch’ list — accounts that are explicitly reserved for internal sales (enterprise strategic) to avoid accidental handoffs.
olivia_r: I'll create a RevOps ticket PRJ-1284 and start the automation spec. ETA for basic field + 72h flow = 5 business days. Will share spec doc in the ticket.
integration-bot: PRJ-1284 created by @olivia_r — link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRJ-1284
maria_p: Thanks — I'll assemble the pilot playbook (intake form, routing rules, announcement checklist, acceptance SLAs) and drop a draft in #partnerships by EOD Friday. If anyone wants to be in the pilot working group, reply here.
dan_s: I'll nominate 2 AEs for the pilot.
hao_w: I'll loop in partner leads and confirm EdgeWorks / CloudForge by EOD.
olivia_r: Will post the automation spec in PRJ-1284 when draft is ready.
jess_legal: I'll attach the MOU template draft to PRJ-1284 in the next 48 hours.
maria_p: Great — small ask: keep the pilot limited to 2 partners so we can iterate quickly. We'll use the pilot to validate thresholds and the 72h acceptance flow.
